plain_definition: A private sector-led project to let different UK banks' tokenised deposits interact with each other, so that programmable commercial bank money can support both wholesale and everyday payments. It is a shared, cross-bank initiative -- distinct from any one bank's own tokenised-deposit product, a stablecoin, or the Bank of England's proposed digital pound.
formal_definition: Described in the Wholesale Digital Markets Champion's first report (HM Treasury, 13 July 2026) as a new private sector-led platform enabling different banks' tokenised deposits to interact, and as an approved participant in the Bank of England's Synchronisation Lab; the report recommends industry 'continue to build GBTD at scale.'
